newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold ends down on imrpoved supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold ends down on imrpoved supply.

text.p: Indian gold prices ended Monday lower on falling prices in international markets and improved local supplies, dealers said.
"Arrivals were low last week due to strict vigilance by the police department ahead of Republic Day but now supplies have again picked up," one trader said.
Prices of gold biscuits (116.50 gramme) fell 300 rupees to 57,400 rupees per piece.
Silver prices opened lower on overnight losses in global markets but fresh industrial support and limited arrivals steadied the market, traders said.
